title: Tensoring by finite locally free module is exact
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $\mathcal P$ be a finite locally free $\mathcal O_X$-module: there is an open cover $(V_a)$ of $X$ such that $\mathcal P|_{V_a}\cong\mathcal O_{V_a}^{\oplus d_a}$ for integers $d_a\geq0$ (compare the constant-rank notion of [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]). The functor on $\mathcal O_X$-modules sending $\mathcal G$ to $\mathcal P\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G$ preserves short exact sequences (equivalently, is exact). Tensor products and the module category are as in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

source.place: Proof, sentence asserting exactness of F^vee tensor -

proof.text: The dual P^vee is finite locally free, and the canonical bidual map P to P^{vee vee} is an isomorphism. On every trivializing open with rank d, dualization takes the finite free module O^d to O^d and biduality is the standard evaluation isomorphism, including d = 0 and varying local ranks. Reuse the already proved source declarations AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.dual and SheafOfModules.isIso_bidual, rather than reproving these local calculations.

Apply [lem-sc-ext-evaluation] to P^vee and its naturality in the second argument. Compose tensoring by the biduality isomorphism with its natural evaluation isomorphism to obtain a natural isomorphism tensorLeft P to ihom P^vee. In Lean this uses the already proved source instance isIso_dualTensorHom_of_isFiniteLocallyFree and lemma dualTensorHom_naturality_right in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.HomTensor.LocallyFree; no still-unproved evaluation declaration is needed.

By the tensor-Hom adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-module-tensor-hom-adjunction], internal Hom from P^vee is a right adjoint, so preserves limits. Transport finite-limit preservation across the natural isomorphism of step 2 using Mathlib preservesFiniteLimits_of_natIso. Tensoring by P is itself the left adjoint in the tensor-Hom adjunction, so preserves colimits and in particular finite colimits. Lean uses ihom.adjunction and Adjunction.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits, with the small-colimit universe specialized to 0.
